label: prf:boltzmann-constant
title: Proof of boltzmann constant
html:
Proof. The quantum ideal gas law (see quantum ideal gas law) gives P_q V_q = N T_q = N \hbar_q at leading order. The classical form is PV = N k_B T.

In this framework, the temperature T_q = \hbar_q (quantum temperature) naturally carries units of energy. It is the Reeb tick rate, not a statistical parameter. Comparing the two forms yields:

  N \, k_B \, T_q \;=\; N \, \hbar_q
  \quad\Longrightarrow\quad
  k_B \;=\; 1.

The Boltzmann constant is unity because the temperature is defined in energy units. We require no separate conversion factor for a "degrees of freedom" temperature scale.

In SI units, physical temperature T_{\mathrm{phys}} is measured in kelvin, and k_B = 1.381 \times 10^{-23} J/K provides the energy conversion. We predict k_B T_{\mathrm{phys}} = \hbar_q. The thermal energy per degree of freedom precisely equals the quantum Planck constant. \qquad\square
